description: Add one step to a checklist and return its I01-style id: the text, an optional section heading, and whether it is required. A required step that is unanswered or failed blocks sign-off; an optional one does not.

checklist.description: The checklist id, e.g. CL-0001, or its name when only one carries it

note.description: Guidance printed under the step, e.g. the tolerance or the standard it is checked against

position.description: Insert at this 1-based position instead of at the end. Existing steps keep their ids

required.description: Whether sign-off is blocked while this step is unanswered or failed. Default true

section.description: A heading to group this step under, e.g. Exterior. Steps keep the order they were added within a section

text.description: The step, as the person doing it will read it, e.g. Tyre pressures checked and recorded

name: checklist_item_add
title: Add a step to a checklist
